name: 'ae' livery
description: White fuselage with a large mid-blue 'AirEuropa' in a bold rounded lower-case sans ahead of the wing. Blue fin (a little darker toward the tip) with the white 'ae' ligature. Blue winglets with a white 'ae'; white engines.

sources.title: EC-OSS AIRCRAFT Boeing 737 MAX 8 (1a).jpg (CC BY 4.0)
sources.note: 737-8 EC-OSS, left side, 2026-08-04: title position, winglet, engines. Re-checked 2026-11-15: fitted to the measured 737-800 shape (doors pinned; within 17-33 px, the MAX 8's doors sit a little differently): the title's ends and height.

sources.title: EC-OPA AIRCRAFT Boeing 737 MAX 8 (1c).jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0)
sources.note: 737-8 EC-OPA, right side, 2026-01-23: the fin and its 'ae'.

sources.title: EC-MPS EHAM 1.jpg (CC0)
sources.note: 737-800 EC-MPS, left side from above, 2018-05-06: title and lower fin.

logos.description: The Air Europa 'ae' symbol: a lower-case a and e joined as one ligature, round and heavy, in white, high on the fin.
The 'ae' on the winglets' outer face.
Small Spanish flag ahead of the registration over the rear windows.

titles.style: 'AirEuropa' set solid, capital A and E, in a bold rounded geometric sans; the windows run through it.

notes: The fin blue darkens slightly toward the tip (a soft gradient), drawn as one blue. The 'ae' symbol came with the 2015 rebrand (date from memory, not a source in hand, so 'from' is left out). Belly not seen: white. A few aircraft fly in SkyTeam colors. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on EC-OSS (737-8, side-on, 2026-08-04): the title runs x 0.147-0.375 with its baseline just under the windows and its capitals about 1.3 m tall; lowercase 0.68 of the capitals.
history: Replaced Skyarium v1's approximation (navy and magenta). Before the 'ae' scheme Air Europa flew white with a blue fin and navy/blue titles.
